plan.notes: Source: UGA Bulletin 2026-2027, Art BFA - Printmaking (BFA), Four-Year Program of Study (https://bulletin.uga.edu/Program/Details/45379?IDc=ARTS). Plan transcribed 2026-10-06 from the program page's semester-by-semester plan (Fall/Spring/Summer Year 1-4; empty/N/A terms omitted). Course codes, titles, and credits are as published in the plan tables. Area/elective descriptors in the plan are transcribed as choice placeholders with credits per the published degree-requirement hour declarations; total_credits is the true item sum. allow_repeated_courses=true: ARST 4345/6345 "Advanced Print Studio" (repeatable to 6 hours, 3cr each) is listed by the official UGA Bulletin 2026-2027 four-year plan in FOUR semesters (Spring Year 3, Summer Year 3, Fall Year 4, Spring Year 4). BFA studio course repeats deliberately; all instances transcribed faithfully.
